summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Add-on Order feature. Admin endpoints (list, filter, status transitions with forward-only guard + terminal rejection, delivery URL validation + auto-advance to delivered, backfill idempotent) all pass. Work Queue integrates addon_processing. Admin UI /admin/addon-orders renders 3 seeded rows with correct badges, backfill button toasts, status action buttons advance state, and delivery modal saves https URL + toasts 'Hasil tersimpan & label diberi tahu'. Label side (dashboard + release detail) renders the 'Layanan Tambahan Rilisan' section with status badge and 'Buka / Unduh hasil' link once KYC state was completed for the demo label.

minor.issue: Endpoint is behind ensure_label_kyc but the seeded 'Demo Label VIP' account has no bank_account / kyc_document, so it returns 403 KYC_REQUIRED (missing_keys=[bank]). Labels cannot view their paid add-on deliveries until full KYC verified. Consider either (a) whitelisting /api/label/addon-orders similar to /api/label/dashboard so labels can see their paid services regardless of KYC state, or (b) seeding demo_vip with completed bank + verified kyc_document so the feature is exerciseable end-to-end from the seed alone.

action_items: Decide whether /api/label/addon-orders should require full KYC. If not, add it to KYC_ALLOWED_LABEL_PREFIXES in backend/routes/deps.py or add a lighter gate. Otherwise, update the demo_vip seed to include bank_account + verified kyc_document so the label-side UI is testable from the seed alone.

During testing I inserted a bank_account row and set kyc_status=verified with a dummy verified kyc_document for the demo_vip label (label_id 896affd2-11a6-4805-a11f-1d1f32300dd9) to exercise the label endpoint + UI. Also seeded add-on order for release Cinta Sederhana was advanced to 'Selesai' with delivery URL https://example.com/hasil-video.mp4 and Kota Mati remains 'Diproses'. Reseed if a clean demo state is desired.
critical_code_review_comments: sync_release_addon_orders uses dedupe_key {release_id}:{product_id} which correctly makes creation idempotent.
admin_update_status correctly rejects backward moves and terminal transitions with 409. The 'delivered' -> 'completed' path works, and 'cancelled' is accepted from any non-terminal.
admin_set_delivery only blocks 'cancelled' orders; a delivery PATCH on a 'completed' order is still accepted (not necessarily wrong but worth confirming as intended).
Label list endpoint filters strictly by label_id; cross-tenant leakage not observed.

success_rate.backend: 100% (4 passed, 1 conditional skip that then verified live via curl)

seed_data_creation: Added bank_accounts doc + kyc_documents doc + kyc_status=verified for demo_vip label solely to exercise label endpoint. Advanced 1 demo addon_order (Cinta Sederhana Visualizer Landscape) to delivered->completed with delivery_url https://example.com/hasil-video.mp4.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter76_addon_orders.py covers admin flow. test_label_sees_only_own auto-skips if the label endpoint returns 403 KYC_REQUIRED so it's safe on clean seed. If retesting label UI, ensure demo_vip has completed KYC in DB.
rca of the issue: Only observation: label add-on list is gated by ensure_label_kyc through require_label. Since the demo seed for demo_vip does not include a bank_account/kyc_document, GET /api/label/addon-orders responds 403 with missing_keys=[bank]. Mitigation: whitelist the endpoint in KYC_ALLOWED_LABEL_PREFIXES, or seed demo_vip with complete KYC (bank_account row + kyc_document status=verified + labels.kyc_status=verified + labels.kyc_document_id set).
